$comment: Test runners of this pack, for `precheck.testRunners` in .factory/config.json (schema: scripts/feature-verification/lib/runners.mjs). Refer to one with "<pack>/<name>" or to all with "<pack>"; runners are tried in this order. `verified` says whether the run command was executed against a sample project when the pack was written.

runners.name: mstest
runners.description: MSTest (MSTest.Sdk or the MSTest packages): projects whose project file mentions MSTest.
runners.verifiedNote: Commands are the ones the eShop pipeline ran before the extraction (dotnet test on Microsoft.Testing.Platform); not re-executed here.

runners.name: xunit
runners.description: xUnit v3 on Microsoft.Testing.Platform: every other .NET test project.
runners.verifiedNote: Commands are the ones the eShop pipeline ran before the extraction; not re-executed here.

sharedFixture.note: declare one [CollectionDefinition(Name)] class implementing ICollectionFixture<TheFixture>, put [Collection(Name)] on every class that uses the fixture, and remove their IClassFixture<TheFixture>; make the tests independent of each other's data (unique ids, restore shared rows)
